styles.name: Studio photo
styles.description: A true-to-life photograph in soft studio light
styles.fragment: a high-end studio photograph: soft diffused key light from the upper left, gentle fill, crisp focus with shallow depth of field, true-to-life colour and fine surface texture
styles.lettering: bold dimensional letters standing in the scene, lit like everything else

styles.name: Film photo
styles.description: A cinematic 35 mm photograph with natural light and grain
styles.fragment: a cinematic photograph shot on 35 mm film: natural motivated light, gentle film grain, soft halation on the highlights, a rich but restrained colour grade, full-frame composition
styles.lettering: large letters that belong to the scene and are lit by its light

styles.name: Product render
styles.description: A polished 3D render with studio light and real materials
styles.fragment: a polished 3D product render: physically based materials, soft global illumination, subtle reflections and ambient occlusion, gently bevelled edges, clean studio lighting
styles.lettering: extruded 3D letters in a material that matches the subject

styles.name: Isometric 3D
styles.description: A tidy 3D model at the isometric angle
styles.fragment: an isometric 3D render: true isometric view with parallel projection, clean simplified forms with crisp bevelled edges, soft even studio light, gentle ambient occlusion
styles.lettering: extruded 3D letters lying in the isometric plane

styles.name: Tilt-shift miniature
styles.description: A real scene photographed like a tiny scale model
styles.fragment: a tilt-shift miniature photograph: handmade scale-model materials, a narrow band of sharp focus with soft blur above and below, bright toy-like colour, warm late-afternoon light
styles.lettering: bold letters built as a scale-model sign in the scene
checks: blur above and below a sharp band

styles.name: Clay
styles.description: Soft handmade modelling clay in warm light
styles.fragment: a handmade clay render: soft matte modelling clay with fingerprints and tool marks, rounded chunky forms, warm soft studio light, gentle shadows

styles.name: Glass
styles.description: Sculpted translucent glass with refraction and caustics
styles.fragment: sculpted translucent glass: smooth polished forms, refraction and bright caustic highlights, subtle coloured tints inside the glass, soft reflections, a dark-to-light studio gradient

styles.name: Neon
styles.description: Glowing neon tubes against deep darkness
styles.fragment: glowing neon light tubes: bent glass tubes with saturated coloured glow, soft bloom, faint reflections on a dark surrounding surface, crisp tube ends and small mounting clips
keep_out: stray words such as OPEN or BAR

styles.name: Enamel
styles.description: Glossy cloisonné enamel with raised gold outlines
styles.fragment: cloisonné enamel: thin raised gold wire outlines, smooth glossy fields of bright enamel colour, a soft polished sheen with one clean highlight

styles.name: Embroidery
styles.description: Dense satin-stitch embroidery in raised glossy thread
styles.fragment: dense satin-stitch embroidery: raised glossy thread, visible stitch direction, fine fill texture, a stitched outline around every shape, soft raking light across the threads
keep_out: a patch with a sewn edge

styles.name: Papercut
styles.description: Layered cut paper with real shadows between the layers
styles.fragment: layered cut paper: stacked layers of matte coloured paper with clean cut edges, soft shadows between the layers giving real depth, gentle overhead light
styles.lettering: letters cut from paper, raised on their own layer

styles.name: Stained glass
styles.description: Jewel-toned leaded glass lit from behind
styles.fragment: leaded stained glass: bold dark lead lines, jewel-toned translucent glass pieces with slight texture and tiny bubbles, warm light glowing through from behind

styles.name: Oil painting
styles.description: Rich classical oil paint with dramatic light
styles.fragment: a classical oil painting: rich layered oil paint with visible impasto brushstrokes, luminous glazes, dramatic directional light and deep shadows
styles.lettering: hand-painted lettering in the same oil paint

styles.name: Watercolour
styles.description: Loose, luminous transparent washes
styles.fragment: a loose watercolour painting: soft wet-in-wet washes, granulating pigment, crisp dry-brush accents, luminous transparent colour with a few deep saturated darks

styles.name: Gouache
styles.description: Opaque matte paint in flat, harmonious shapes
styles.fragment: an opaque gouache painting: flat matte colour shapes, soft visible brush texture, confident simplified forms, a limited harmonious palette

styles.name: Pencil
styles.description: A detailed graphite drawing with a full tonal range
styles.fragment: a detailed graphite pencil drawing: confident contour lines, fine hatching and cross-hatching, smooth tonal shading from pale grey to deep black
styles.lettering: hand-drawn outlined letters shaded in pencil

styles.name: 70s airbrush
styles.description: Silky gradients, glossy chrome and star glints
styles.fragment: a 1970s airbrush illustration: silky airbrushed gradients, glossy chrome highlights with small star-shaped glints, a saturated violet-to-tangerine palette, soft glow

styles.name: Woodblock print
styles.description: Carved keylines, flat colour and wood grain
styles.fragment: a traditional woodblock-printed illustration: carved black keylines, flat areas of indigo, vermilion and muted ochre, soft bokashi colour gradients, visible wood grain in the colour
styles.lettering: carved block lettering in keyline black

styles.name: Linocut
styles.description: Bold carved relief in black and one ink
styles.fragment: a bold two-colour linocut illustration: carved shapes with rough gouge marks, solid black and one bright ink, strong contrast, slightly uneven ink texture

styles.name: Risograph
styles.description: Grainy spot colour with slight misregistration
styles.fragment: a risograph-printed illustration: two or three flat spot colours, coarse grain, visible halftone texture, slight misregistration between the colour layers
styles.lettering: bold sans-serif letters printed in one ink

styles.name: Travel poster
styles.description: Mid-century flat colour with bold light
styles.fragment: a mid-century screen-printed illustration: flat interlocking colour shapes, a limited palette of five or six inks, bold simplified light and shadow, fine print grain
styles.lettering: bold retro sans-serif letters in one flat ink
keep_out: a title or tagline nobody asked for

styles.name: Pop art
styles.description: Black outlines, primaries and halftone dots
styles.fragment: a pop-art comic illustration: thick black outlines, flat saturated primary colours, Ben-Day halftone dots, hard graphic shadows

styles.name: Collage
styles.description: Surreal cut paper and photographic fragments
styles.fragment: a surreal cut-paper collage: photographic fragments with torn and scissor-cut edges, halftone texture, layered paper shadows, muted vintage colour
styles.lettering: letters cut from different printed papers

styles.name: Pixel art
styles.description: Crisp 16-bit pixels and a limited palette
styles.fragment: detailed 16-bit pixel art: crisp square pixels on a strict grid, a limited retro palette, clean dithering, dark one-pixel outlines

styles.name: Blueprint
styles.description: White technical linework on deep blue
styles.fragment: a technical blueprint drawing: fine white linework on deep cyan-blue, precise orthographic construction lines, a faint square grid, a chalky, slightly mottled surface

styles.name: Low poly
styles.description: Faceted 3D in flat-shaded triangles
styles.fragment: a low-poly 3D render: faceted flat-shaded triangles, crisp polygon edges, soft gradient lighting, a clean limited palette

styles.name: Anime
styles.description: Clean cel-shaded illustration
styles.fragment: a cel-shaded anime illustration: clean confident linework, flat cel shading with soft painted gradients, luminous colour, gentle warm light
keep_out: characters or faces nobody asked for

styles.name: Art nouveau
styles.description: Whiplash lines, gold outlines and jewel tones
styles.fragment: an art nouveau illustration: flowing whiplash-curve linework, thin gold outlines, flat muted jewel tones, ornament woven through the design rather than around it

styles.name: Art deco
styles.description: Bold symmetrical geometry in gold and black
styles.fragment: an art deco design: bold symmetrical geometry, stepped forms and radiating lines, metallic gold and black with one rich accent colour, crisp clean edges
styles.lettering: tall geometric deco capitals in gold

styles.name: Synthwave
styles.description: Neon-lit 1980s chrome and haze
styles.fragment: 1980s synthwave rendering: glowing cyan and violet rim light, glossy chrome reflections, deep purple gradients, soft haze with a faint scanline glow
styles.lettering: chrome letters with a neon glow
